title: As long as, unless, in case
summary: Set conditions with `-DIğI sürece` (as long as), `-mAdIkçA` (unless), `-DIğI takdirde`, *hâlinde* and `-(y)AcAk olursa` (in case), place events with *geldiği an*, *geldiği sırada*, *geldiğinden beri* and *gelene kadar*, and pair ideas with *hem … hem*, *ne … ne* and *ister … ister*.
canDo: Say what has to keep being true for something to happen, and what will happen unless something does
Read and write the conditions of rules, tickets and notices
Say exactly when something happened: the moment, just as, ever since, until
Link two ideas with both … and, neither … nor, either … or and whether … or
